<a id="canonical-1303323021021332-1222223222020023-2022331033202211-0200131033110310-3211031000031213-1101221222111013-3103110212123311-0123032311311221"></a>

#### `cloud_init_config` property

Type: `"string"`. Computed, Sensitive.

Cloud-init template with an unresolved token placeholder; substitute a separately issued site-bound
JWT before deployment. This sensitive value is stored in Terraform state; protect state access
accordingly.

<a id="canonical-3233232221112313-1130213123203101-2232203032113322-0013321200100223-3323132120212333-2232332200222020-1032310103100203-3130120213120203"></a>
